title: Plan Totals
description: Headline figures for the whole plan: the strip a planner reads before any breakdown. Counts and sums that a breakdown also reports MUST agree with it, within the rounding of the figures shown.

budget.description: Total spend of the plan, in the breakdown currency.

market_count.description: Number of markets in the plan.

station_count.description: Number of stations or networks in the plan.

market_audience.description: Target-audience persons in the plan's markets, in audience_basis.reach_unit.

estimated_audience.description: The plan's estimated audience: the persons in the target audience the plan is expected to reach. Where the seller computes it as the campaign window's reach, it equals that reach_frequency point.

average_index.description: Average of the market-slice indexes weighted by each slice's target_persons, relative to audience_basis.index_baseline.

impressions.description: Estimated impressions in the plan's target audience (audience_basis), not total audience.

grps.description: Gross rating points of the plan, rated against audience_basis.universe.

cpp.description: Plan cost per point: budget / grps, in the breakdown currency.

cpm.description: Plan cost per thousand impressions: budget / impressions * 1000, in the breakdown currency.

reach_frequency.description: Reach and frequency by window. Windows MUST be unique.
